channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The Silicon Tape finally moved: DigitalOcean's public spot list reprinted NVIDIA HGX B300 at $8.00/GPU-hr (was $11.19 on 22 Sep) and AMD Instinct MI350X at $3.00 (was $4.00), while Lambda H100 on-demand held $3.99 and B200 $6.69 across a 67-confirm / 2-tick / 0-NEW re-read. Overnight conversion stamps were scarce. Fermi Campus 1 and TensorWave signed a First Amendment pushing the Project Matador 222 MW lease close from 30 Sep to 31 Oct 2026 (~$6.5B expected 15-year revenue unchanged; IG guaranty and project financing still open). Host Digital (NYSE American: HOST) is trading after its Sep 17 merger and highlighted northeast Oklahoma Site I (55 MW gross / 43 MW critical IT, ~$1.25B base-term take-or-pay) plus a Preferential Rights path to Site II (20/16 MW, ~$391M base-term) that remains subject to definitive agreements. CleanSpark's $2.276B Sandersville notes are still priced with close targeted 25 Sep — EFTS shows no closing 8-K through 23 Sep. PUCT 58481 Interchange is unchanged at items 218/219. No new country-level Wire ids today.
